patch.summary:
Choose respond.io only if your buying job matches “Omnichannel customer messaging platform (WhatsApp + other channels) with shared inbox and ” rather than Slack's shape. Choose Slack only if your buying job matches “Channel-based team messaging platform — Free $0, Pro $7.25/user/month annual, Business+ $1” rather than respond.io's shape. Workflow advantage: respond.io leans customer-messaging, whatsapp-support; Slack leans team-communication. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: respond.io is Omnichannel customer messaging platform (WhatsApp + other channels) with shared inbox and AI — Starter from $79/month annual-equivalent.; Slack is Channel-based team messaging platform — Free $0, Pro $7.25/user/month annual, Business+ $15, Enterprise+ contact sales; huddles for light vi.
- Company-size focus: respond.io (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Slack (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: respond.io-leaning customer-messaging, whatsapp-support vs Slack-leaning team-communication.
- Researched limits: respond.io — Not a business phone system — no IVR, queues or PSTN calling product; Slack — Not a business phone system — no cloud phone, call routing, recording or power dialer.
